known_issues.title: MsMpEng.exe High CPU Usage During Archive Scanning
symptoms: MsMpEng.exe consuming 50-100% CPU for extended periods
Disk I/O spikes matching Defender process
known_issues.root_cause: Windows Defender is caught in a scanning loop when encountering deeply nested archive files (.zip, .rar) or large developer directories (like node_modules).
remediation: Add exclusion for specific developer directories
Limit Defender CPU usage via PowerShell: Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor 30
Schedule full scans during off-peak hours only
references: Microsoft Support: High CPU usage by Windows Defender

known_issues.title: CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor BSOD (PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA)
affected: All Windows systems running CrowdStrike Falcon agent version 7.15+
symptoms: Continuous Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) loops
known_issues.root_cause: A malformed channel file update pushed by CrowdStrike caused an out-of-bounds memory read in the csagent.sys kernel driver.
remediation: Boot into Safe Mode or Windows Recovery Environment

known_issues.title: IIS Application Pool Rapid Fail Protection Triggered
symptoms: Event ID 5002 in System Event Log (Application Pool stopped due to Rapid Fail Protection)
Multiple w3wp.exe crashes (Event ID 1000) within a short timeframe
known_issues.root_cause: The w3wp.exe worker process crashed multiple times (default is 5 times within 5 minutes), causing IIS to disable the application pool to protect the system.
remediation: Inspect Application Event Log for Event ID 1000 to find the faulting module
Capture a crash dump using DebugDiag or ProcDump
Temporarily increase the Rapid Fail Protection limit if caused by a known intermittent startup issue
